phases: Phase 1: Telemetry Audit (Entry: telemetry data ingested; Exit: double-count defect mapped and documented in funnel steps 3 and 6). Workstreams: Telemetry Data Validation (Owner: Sarah Lin), Funnel Step Mapping (Owner: David Chen). Artifacts: Step-level drop-off report, double-count defect annotation. Dependencies: Requires raw telemetry from Q1–Q2; must be completed before funnel analysis. Coverage: All 7 steps in the onboarding funnel. Phase 2: Moderated Study Synthesis (Entry: 12 sessions analyzed with persona-specific insights; Exit: behavioral patterns mapped to funnel steps). Workstreams: Session Transcription (Owner: Maya Patel), Pattern Categorization (Owner: James Wu). Artifacts: Persona behavior matrix, facilitator interpretation log. Dependencies: Must complete Phase 1; study inputs must be de-identified before analysis. Coverage: All 3 personas across all 7 funnel steps. Phase 3: Survey Analysis and Competitive Scan (Entry: survey data processed with skew correction; Exit: validated segment definitions). Workstreams: Survey Skew Adjustment (Owner: Elena Kim), Competitive Benchmarking (Owner: Robert Tan). Artifacts: Segment definition document, competitive feature comparison matrix. Dependencies: Must complete Phase 2; survey data must be pre-processed before analysis. Coverage: All 340 survey responses with segment definitions. Phase 4: Onboarding Redesign Draft (Entry: evidence-based design recommendations finalized; Exit: draft interface flows approved). Workstreams: Recommendation Drafting (Owner: Chloe Liu), Evidence Mapping (Owner: Thomas Reed). Artifacts: Design recommendation document, evidence traceability matrix. Dependencies: Must complete Phase 3; all inputs must be cross-verified with telemetry and study findings. Coverage: All 7 funnel steps with design interventions. Phase 5: Prototype Review and Iteration (Entry: prototype delivered to stakeholders; Exit: final design approved). Workstreams: Prototype Development (Owner: Ben Carter), Stakeholder Feedback Loop (Owner: Lisa Wong). Artifacts: Interactive prototype, stakeholder feedback summary. Dependencies: Must complete Phase 4; prototype must be reviewed by UX lead before iteration. Coverage: All core onboarding flows with user testing.
critical_path: Hard dependencies: Telemetry audit completes before funnel analysis begins; moderated study synthesis must finish before survey analysis starts; all design recommendations are contingent on completed evidence mapping. Soft dependencies: Survey skew correction may delay competitive scan if data is incomplete; prototype feedback may extend iteration timeline by up to 3 days. Critical path sequence: Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3 → Phase 4 → Phase 5. Duration: 68 days (derived from sum of phase durations with no overlap). Slip threshold: If any phase exceeds its duration by more than 7 days, the critical path must be recomputed.
risk_register: Risk: Telemetry double-count defect not discounted in funnel analysis. Scale: High (impacts accuracy of drop-off metrics); Owner: Sarah Lin; Mitigation: Apply manual correction to steps 3 and 6 during funnel analysis; Early-warning indicator: Drop-off rate at step 3 shows a 15% increase vs baseline; Check: Telemetry validation report must include defect annotation. Risk: Survey skew inflates perceived user satisfaction; Scale: Medium (distorts segment representation); Owner: Elena Kim; Mitigation: Apply statistical weighting to underrepresented segments; Early-warning indicator: Segment response rate below 30%; Check: Survey data pre-processing log must show skew correction applied. Risk: Moderated sessions lack depth on step 5; Scale: High (creates blind spots in design); Owner: James Wu; Mitigation: Conduct follow-up session with persona B at step 5; Early-warning indicator: Facilitator notes indicate missing behavioral cues; Check: Session transcript must include explicit note of gap. Risk: Competitive scan underrepresents feature parity; Scale: Medium; Owner: Robert Tan; Mitigation: Add one additional product to benchmarking set; Early-warning indicator: Feature comparison shows >20% gap in onboarding features; Check: Competitive scan document includes full feature list with source.
decision_log: Decision: To include step 3 and 6 drop-off metrics in funnel analysis, despite double-count defect. Evidence line: Telemetry data from Q1–Q2 shows a 15% higher drop-off at step 3 and 6; risk if assumption wrong: Overestimation of user loss leads to misaligned design focus. Decision: To apply skew correction to survey responses using weighted averages. Evidence line: Survey response distribution shows skew toward high-satisfaction users (n=280); risk if assumption wrong: Underrepresentation of low-satisfaction users leads to flawed segment insights. Decision: To conduct a follow-up session with persona B at step 5. Evidence line: Facilitator notes from Phase 2 indicate lack of observed behavior in step 5; risk if assumption wrong: Design fails to address key user pain point. Decision: To expand competitive benchmarking set to include one additional product (Notion). Evidence line: Notion has a more streamlined onboarding flow than current offering; risk if assumption wrong: Overestimation of feature parity leads to design misalignment.
